text.en: Pet owners consistently praise the veterinary team at this West Hills clinic, specifically mentioning Dr. Reimer and Dr. Shinkle. Reviewers describe the staff as caring, attentive, and generous with their time when explaining complex medical diagnoses. Multiple clients who have brought their pets here for years highlight the doctors' thorough follow-up care and reassuring demeanor during stressful medical situations.

Clients report positive clinical outcomes for both dogs and exotic animals undergoing intensive medical treatment. Reviewers highlight successful recoveries in difficult cases, including prolonged respiratory or bacterial illnesses in birds and tortoises. Long-term pet owners express confidence in the doctors' clinical skills, noting that the medical care reliably resolved complex ailments.

In addition to standard canine care, reviewers emphasize the hospital's exceptional handling of exotic pets such as parrots, desert tortoises, and rabbits. Pet parents appreciate that the veterinary team possesses specialized knowledge required for non-traditional companion animals. Owners note that the practitioners treat sensitive species with genuine patience and clinical expertise.

q.en: Does All Pets Medical Centre treat exotic animals and birds?

a.en: Yes, reviewers frequently highlight care for exotic species including rabbits, parrots, and desert tortoises.

q.en: Can the clinic accommodate urgent visits for sick pets?

a.en: Yes, clients mention that the doctors work to fit in established patients when urgent medical issues arise.

q.en: How do clients perceive the clinic's veterinary pricing?

a.en: Reviewers describe the pricing as reasonable and fair, particularly given the specialized care provided for exotics.

q.en: Are the veterinarians communicative about treatment plans?

a.en: Yes, pet owners consistently note that Dr. Reimer and Dr. Shinkle take ample time to explain diagnoses and therapeutic options.
